_note: Cover stickers (D-86). Each has a trade-off. Most unlock through an achievement. Labels say what a sticker does, never if it is a good choice. Teaching-model values.

new.label: NEW!
new.does: More reach on a product's first 2 posts. After that, viewers who saw it before scroll past.

sale.label: SALE
sale.does: More people click. Fewer of them buy, because they expect a lower price than you show.

cod.label: COD OK
cod.does: More viewers buy, and fewer comments ask if you take cash on delivery.

legit.label: Legit seller ✓
legit.does: More viewers buy while your rating is 4.5 or higher. Below that, it does nothing.

hot.label: TRENDING 🔥
hot.does: More reach when many people want the item right now. Less reach when they do not: it looks fake.

free.label: Free shipping
free.does: Many more viewers buy. You pay ₱30 of the delivery for every order from this post.

zero.label: Always in stock
zero.does: More viewers buy. If this post gets a missed sale, your rating drops more.

follow.label: Follow for more
follow.does: More of the people who like this post follow you.
